title: Handle future child buttons
summary: A delegated handler is attached to a parent and checks matching child elements.
introduction: A delegated handler is attached to a parent and checks matching child elements. Your task: Add a second child button after the handler is attached.
learningObjectives: Add a second child button after the handler is attached.
Explain the example for handle future child buttons

blocks.text: A delegated handler is attached to a parent and checks matching child elements. It can work for children added later.
Use a local HTML page that loads jQuery 3.7 before these scripts. Examples need that library; the plain playground does not include it. Put the script after the example markup.
Read the code step by step

items: The listener belongs to the parent #books element.
The button selector matches the event's child control; a normal function makes this refer to that matched button.

blocks.text: Clicking the child button logs its data-title value through the parent handler.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: This example uses a normal function so this refers to the matched button. Arrow functions do not bind their own this.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add a second child button after the handler is attached.
